input.quote: No minimum quantity or purchase commitment applies. Customer pays only for Services ordered in a mutually executed Order Form, and its decision not to enter another Order Form is not a breach or shortfall.
input.rationale: The Agreement meets our preferred position: § 2.1 (p0012) expressly disclaims any minimum quantity or purchase commitment and confirms that declining a further Order Form is neither a breach nor a shortfall, so fees are payable only for Services actually ordered. § 7.1 (p0026) reinforces this by barring any minimum-use or similar charge not identified in an Order Form, and § 12.3 (p0050) records that we have made no minimum-volume commitment. No take-or-pay, volume floor, or shortfall penalty is imposed on us anywhere in the document; the only "shortfall" references (§§ 22.2–22.3) concern audit underpayments for usage actually consumed, which is not a purchase commitment. No redline required.
